Dexel records COUNTS and DURATIONS only — never typed content, clipboard,
window titles, or URLs, and this is enforced by tests that fail the build.
If your idea needs raw content, it likely can't ship as described; a
count/duration-shaped version might. See docs/adr/0002 and CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->
